purpose: Govern, BEFORE the merge is attempted, the reconciliation of the closed Wave2 B2/B3 methodology lineage (codex/w2-methodology-objects-r1 @ 102a75cc) into the already-integrated Commercial V1 Product lineage (integration/commercial-v1 @ d56d44a3) on the candidate branch codex/commercial-v1-wave2-reconciliation-r1. It pins the exact conflict set established by read-only git merge-tree, the semantic requirement of each side per path, the mandatory preservation criteria, the prohibited shortcuts, and the exact protected-path grant the ODS scope gate may resolve on this branch. It authorizes reconciliation ONLY of the paths it lists.
scope_note: APPEND-ONLY. Does not rewrite, supersede, reinterpret or restate ODS_V1_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json, ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM v1.0.1..v1.0.8, any FIB/PC-01B/IM-01B artifact, docs/ops/wave2/W2_B3_FOCUSED_ADVERSARIAL_CLOSURE_AUDIT_v1.0.0.json or any other Wave2 closure artifact, or the accepted Product integration audit (PR #48). HPO-ODS-W2-01 through W2-07 are FROZEN_UNCHANGED. The materialization step id HPO-ODS-W2-08 is the next sequential HPO-ODS-W2 identifier after the seven already frozen (W2-01..W2-07); it is bound to the HPO mission COMMERCIAL-V1-WAVE2-RECONCILIATION-R1, which is the human authorization for this artifact. Registering the grant in scripts/ods-scope.ts PROTECTED_GRANTS and extending the closed-world enumeration in tests/ods/ods-scope.test.ts (total count 4 -> 5, every existing assertion preserved byte-for-byte) is the established mechanical companion of every protected-path authority since HPO-ODS-W2-01 and is not a widening of that mechanism.

pins.forensics_method: git merge-base; git diff-tree -r --name-status <merge-base> <side>; blob-id comparison per overlapping path (git rev-parse <side>:<path>); git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only <A> <B> (read-only, no merge state entered).

forensics.lineage_note: The Product-integrated line already carries the closed Wave2 B1 state (migrations 0048-0052, evidence services, W2_B1 authority) as identical blobs — HPO-ODS-W2-02 transported it. Wave2 B2/B3 (0053-0060, proxies, materiality, dispositions, filter justification) exists only on the Wave2 line. The Product line alone carries the main security closeout (f7bbba4 / PR #47), HPO-ODS-W2-03..W2-07 (0044 guard, managed role identities, global-catalog closed world, release-gate repoint, B0 probe regeneration), the Commercial V1 product/onboarding/design work and the post-audit B0/CI fixes.

reconciliation_policy.A: Production security closeout from main (f7bbba4, PR #47) must survive.
reconciliation_policy.B: Accepted Product integration semantics (PR #48) and its post-audit B0/CI fixes must survive.
reconciliation_policy.C: Closed Wave2 B2/B3 methodology semantics must be incorporated intact.
reconciliation_policy.D: A path changed independently on both lines is NEVER resolved by choosing a whole side without semantic comparison; a whole-side blob is taken only where read-only forensics proved it a strict superset of the other side (recorded per path below).
reconciliation_policy.E: Migrations already closed in Wave2 (0053-0060 and policy 010) are preserved exactly, numbering intact; the Product line added no migration after 0052, so no numbering collision exists. Any collision discovered at merge time is a STOP.
reconciliation_policy.F: Calculation control: the system calculates; Stella may analyze/explain but never becomes calculation authority.
reconciliation_policy.G: NULL/unknown != 0 (AG-B3-2 no-ratio null, AG-B3-4 FILTER_VALUE_UNKNOWN on the authoritative path).
reconciliation_policy.H: Historical evidence cannot be rewritten: every docs/ops/wave2/**, docs/ops/reeng/**, docs/ops/ods/** artifact of either side lands as its own exact blob.
reconciliation_policy.I: Human approval boundaries cannot be weakened (evidence sufficiency at approval, approved-run disposition immutability, analyst+/impact_manager+/organization_admin+ floors).
reconciliation_policy.J: Tenant isolation and authorization cannot regress (org-scoped predicates, RLS policies 0048-0060/010, database entry-point identity contexts; allowlisted entry points stay at 16).

high_risk_paths.note: Extracted from the predicted auto-merge tree and diffed against the Wave2 blob: the only difference is the Product-side pure extraction buildReadinessIssues (RE-U1 U1-F04 / RE-U4 sroi_remediation_matrix) with project-scoped CTAs; every Wave2 B2/B3 semantic (bound-version monetary resolution, FIBIU-08 version approval double-assertion, materiality exclusion, FILTER_VALUE_UNKNOWN authoritative semantics, null no-ratio, itemized skips, dispositions, coverage) is byte-identical to Wave2. No duplicated definitions. Must still be audited function-by-function after the merge (Phase 7) and covered by tests/sroi-calculation.golden.test.ts, tests/sroi-calculation.service.test.ts, tests/b3-completeness.no-ratio.test.ts, lib/pipeline/sroi-remediation-destinations.test.ts.
Both sides carry the identical B1 assertEvidenceSufficiencyForApproval; Wave2 adds the null-safe compareCalculationRuns ratio delta.
Both sides carry the identical B1 tables; Wave2 adds B2/B3 tables/columns.
Both sides add the B1 actions identically; Wave2 adds B2/B3 actions.
Both sides carry the identical B1 sensitivity governance; Wave2 adds B3 context types. Stella remains explanatory, never calculation authority (policy F).
